integrity: The exact coefficient functional and monomial optimization are imported from arXiv:2610.01500v1. The new step is independently proved by optimizing the integer exponent pattern under a support budget: strict splitting forces maximal allowed support and strict convex smoothing forces balanced exponents. Sharpness is witnessed by the corresponding monomial and its norming diagonal vector. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the maximum-coefficient endpoint and a support restriction on the diagonal weight vector. It does not classify finite coefficient exponents, coefficient-support sparsity of the polynomial, or real-scalar variants. The proof is a short refinement of an exact coefficient estimate, so an equivalent older formulation under monomial-convergence terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact support-budget profile for the weighted maximum coefficient inequality
